existing_updates.title: CS1504
existing_updates.description:
The LEA Professional CS1504 is a 4-channel high-power smart amplifier delivering 1,500 watts per channel at 2Ω, 4Ω, 8Ω, 70V, and 100V, making it ideal for large-scale fixed installations that demand uncompromising headroom. As part of the Network CONNECT Series, it offers three ways to connect: a built-in Wi-Fi access point, an existing Wi-Fi network, or a Local Area Network via FAST Ethernet, eliminating the need to download proprietary software.

The on-board Analog Devices Sharc 96kHz DSP with a 32-bit core provides linear-phase FIR crossovers, up to 4 seconds of delay per channel, 16-band parametric EQ per channel, and real-time load monitoring. Through the LEA CONNECT cloud platform and web-browser UI, integrators can configure, monitor, and troubleshoot from anywhere in the world — no VPN required — while third-party API support enables seamless integration with Crestron, AMX, Q-SYS, and other control systems.
